notes.body:
Model for the hepatic metabolism of canagliflozin.
Canagliflozin is mainly glucuronidated to the inactive O-glucuronides M7 (UGT1A9) and M5 (UGT2B4); the oxidation to M9 by CYP3A4 is minor (about 7 % of the dose) [Mamidi2014, Francke2015].
The metabolism is first order: canagliflozin is far below the Km of the enzymes, its pharmacokinetics are dose proportional from 50 to 300 mg [Devineni2015e].
The glucuronides are exported into the plasma and the bile; the glucuronides of the bile are hydrolysed to canagliflozin in the intestine, the source of most of the canagliflozin of the feces [Mamidi2014, Devineni2015b]. M9 is excreted into the bile.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

Scaling factor of the UGT1A9 activity of the liver (and the kidney, the parameter of the whole-body model replaces both). 1.0: unchanged activity; < 1.0 decreased activity; >1.0 increased activity.
Scaling factor of the UGT2B4 activity. 1.0: unchanged activity; < 1.0 decreased activity; >1.0 increased activity.
Scaling factor of the CYP3A4 activity. 1.0: unchanged activity; < 1.0 decreased activity; >1.0 increased activity.

parameter.name: rate of the canagliflozin exchange of the liver

body.p: Fast exchange: the uptake does not limit the metabolism, which is limited by the hepatic blood flow and the enzymes.

parameter.name: rate of the glucuronidation of canagliflozin to M5 (UGT2B4)

parameter.name: rate of the M5 exchange of the liver

body.p: Fast exchange of the glucuronide between the liver and the plasma (efflux by MRP3, uptake by OATP1B), so that the glucuronide of the plasma is excreted into the bile as well.

parameter.name: rate of the M7 exchange of the liver

body.p: Fast exchange of the glucuronide between the liver and the plasma, see M5EX_k.

parameter.name: rate of the biliary excretion of M5

body.p: The non-renal elimination of the glucuronide: the exposure of M5 increases only 2.4-3.0 fold in severe renal impairment and end stage renal disease [Devineni2015c].
The value of LI__M5BIEX_k is the result of the fit PK_20261019_103422__858e3, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the biliary excretion of M7

body.p: The non-renal elimination of the glucuronide, 2-3 % of the dose is M7 in the feces [Mamidi2014].
